definitions.explanation: A cutting technique where ingredients are sliced very thin (1-2mm). Used when you want ingredients to cook quickly, be tender, or have a delicate texture.

examples.japanese: ⟦{牛肉|ぎゅうにく}→牛肉：02874_gyuuniku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{薄切|うすぎ}り⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦すき{焼|や}き→すき焼き：10368_sukiyaki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: Make sukiyaki with thinly sliced beef.

examples.japanese: しょうが⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{薄切|うすぎ}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。

examples.english: Thinly sliced meat cooks through easily.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
⟦{薄|うす}い→薄い：00764_usui⟧ (thin) + {切|ぎ}り (cutting)

CUTTING TECHNIQUE:
Slice ingredients as thin as possible (1-2mm) using a sharp knife. Often used for meat that will be used in hot pot dishes or stir-fries.

COMMON INGREDIENTS:
- ⟦{牛肉|ぎゅうにく}→牛肉：02874_gyuuniku⟧ - beef (for sukiyaki, shabu-shabu)
- ⟦{豚肉|ぶたにく}→豚肉：02956_butaniku⟧ - pork
- しょう⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ - ginger
- にんにく - garlic
- きゅうり - cucumber

MEAT TERMINOLOGY:
{薄切|うすぎ}り⟦{肉|にく}→肉：02240_niku⟧ is sold specifically for:
- ⟦すき{焼|や}き→すき焼き：10368_sukiyaki⟧ - sukiyaki
- ⟦しゃぶしゃぶ→しゃぶしゃぶ：10479_shabushabu⟧ - shabu-shabu
- ⟦{野菜|やさい}{炒|いた}め→野菜炒め：14803_yasaiitame⟧ - vegetable stir-fry

COMMON PATTERN:
「〜⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{薄切|うすぎ}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧」 - to slice ~ thinly

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {薄切|うすぎ}り - thin slices
- ⟦{厚切|あつぎ}り→厚切り：07476_atsugiri⟧ - thick slices
